rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It executed an order-changing write (modify_pending_order_items on order #W2466703) without first confirming the change with the user. The final response only reported the address update and gave no confirmation or details about the requested exchange, so the user-facing outcome is incomplete and missing critical information. There was also no clear authentication step beyond looking up the user by email before making account and order changes. While the default address was updated (and likely to a DC address from the user’s orders), the lack of confirmation before modifying an order and the incomplete final communication do not meet the pass bar.
